theorem rmo_2000_2
  (x y : ℕ)
  (hx : 0 < x)
  (hy : 0 < y)
  (h : y ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8) :
  x = 9 ∧ y = 11 := by

    by_contra! hx'
    have h1 : (x + 2) ^ 3 < y ^ 3 := by
      have h2 : (x + 2) ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 6 * x ^ 2 + 12 * x + 8 := by ring
      rw [h2]

      rw [h3]

        have h6 : x ≥ 10 := by linarith
        have h7 : x ^ 2 + 33 * x + 19 > 0 := by

    have h4 : y < x + 3 := by
